_note: Query 6 (item #1). cloudtrail start-query then get-query-results against the existing store. Billed per GB scanned (itemized at GATE 2: about 38 GB scanned). Result rows are SUMMARIZED; principals aggregated, no per-event rows recorded. Verify the requestParameters accessor syntax against the CloudTrail Lake SQL docs before first use.

StartQuery.QueryStatement: SELECT eventName, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(eventTime) AS first_seen, MAX(eventTime) AS last_seen FROM 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555 WHERE eventTime > '2026-04-10 00:00:00' AND eventSource = 's3.amazonaws.com' AND element_at(requestParameters, 'bucketName') = 'archive-exports-2023' GROUP BY eventName

_derived_by_day_grouping.note: Same query grouped by week (second call, same scan class). 13 weekly buckets, every one non-zero.
_derived_by_day_grouping.pattern: about 2-3 reads per day spread across the whole window; month-start reads by svc-monthly-close; NOT a single burst
